rule_notes.minimum_days_per_request: A leave request must be at least 1 day.
rule_notes.maximum_days_per_request: A single request may not exceed 15 days.
rule_notes.require_available_balance: Requested days must not exceed the available annual leave balance.
rule_notes.require_active_employment: Only active employees may request leave.
rule_notes.human_approval_required_if_days_gte: Requests of 5 or more days require human approval before any leave action is executed.
